name: Dr. Praveen Gupta
designation: Chairman – MAIINS & Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram

Designation: Chairman – Marengo Asia International Institute of Neuro & Spine (MAIINS) & Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram Chief Clinical Strategy, Growth & Innovation, North India Chief Mentor for Start-ups and Clinical Innovations
About: Dr. Praveen Gupta is a distinguished neurologist with over 20 years of experience in neurology and internal medicine. A DM from AIIMS, New Delhi, and MD from Maulana Azad Medical College, he has pioneered multiple neurological interventions in India — such as the First Brain Pacemaker for Epilepsy in Asia, DBS for Parkinson's, Bone Marrow Transplants for CIDP/MS in Gurugram, and Solitaire Shaunt Mechanical Thrombectomy for Stroke in North India. He established top-tier neurology departments at Fortis, Artemis, and Paras Hospitals, and has been featured in Forbes India as one of the most influential healthcare leaders.
Qualifications: DM Neurology – AIIMS, New Delhi (Gold Medallist)
MD Internal Medicine – Maulana Azad Medical College, Delhi (2002) (Distinction)
MBBS – Maulana Azad Medical College, Delhi (1998)
Experience: Chief of Neurology and Principal Director – Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram & Manesar
Head of Neurology – Paras Hospital, Gurugram
Senior Resident – AIIMS, G.B. Pant, LNJP Hospitals
Key Achievements: First DBS for Parkinson's and Brain Pacemaker for Epilepsy in Asia
India's largest series of Stem Cell Transplants for MS
Published India's first Double-blind Migraine Trial (Topiramate)
Honored with 'Global Indian Brand Leader' by Forbes (2019)

Recipient of 20+ National & International Awards including: Best Neurologist (Times Research Media), Rashtriya Chikitsa Shiromani Award, Indian Medical Tourist Summit Award, Times Power Icons 2025 – Award for Excellence in Neurology, 'Neurologist of the Year' by The Economic Times, and the Prestigious Health Icon Award
Research & Publications: Trials in Migraine, MS, Vascular Dementia, Epilepsy
Faculty at multinational and international conferences
Philanthropy & Innovation: Founded Intellichild program for child development
Mentored health-tech startups like Health Mitra & Affinity
